scope: CODATA physical constants. The checked main imports the explicit 2022 edition, computes the energy of a 500 nm photon in joules and electron volts, and compares it with independent decimal reference values. The source modules are pre-generated; no network request or Python generation is needed to use them. No source edits. This is a check of three constants and one calculation, not revalidation of the complete CODATA tables or uncertainty propagation.
